gloss_en: the voices/sounds of holiness (kolot di-kedushah) — the plural holy voices identified in Likutey Moharan I:22 with holy boldness (azut di-kedushah) and with the shofar blasts (tekiah–shevarim–teruah), which break the brazenness of the body/Sitra Achra and enable drawing close to the true tzaddikim (the holy shepherds)
